title: Generalist Large Language Models Outperform Clinical Tools on Medical Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the medical knowledge and clinician alignment of LLMs using benchmarks like MedQA and HealthBench. Although it includes 'Legal/Ethical Issues' as a sub-category of the USMLE exam metrics, it does not specifically focus on religion, faith, or general ethical/moral frameworks as a core component of the research.
